sections.content: Combine invitations with ya and *todavía* no to talk about plans and preparations. Use ya for completed preparations and todavía no for unfinished ones. Respond to invitations by accepting, explaining what you have already done, or saying what you have not done yet.

items.english: Do you want to come to the celebration?

items.spanish: Sí, claro. Ya he preparado la comida.
items.english: Yes, of course. I have already prepared the food.

items.spanish: Todavía no he comprado la bebida.
items.english: I have not bought the drink yet.
We have already accepted the invitation.

sections.content: Use ya for something completed and *todavía* no for something that has not happened yet.
